province.label: จังหวัด
province.query: SELECT c.chw_code, c.chw_name AS a_name, COALESCE( SUM(s.cnt) FILTER ( WHERE s.nation = '048' ), 0 ) AS tatal_048, COALESCE( SUM(s.cnt) FILTER ( WHERE s.nation = '056' ), 0 ) AS tatal_056, COALESCE( SUM(s.cnt) FILTER ( WHERE s.nation = '057' ), 0 ) AS tatal_057, COALESCE( SUM(s.cnt) FILTER ( WHERE s.nation = '046' ), 0 ) AS tatal_046 FROM chospital_regis c LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} s ON ( s.hospcode = c.hoscode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} ) WHERE c.hostype IN ('05', '06', '07') AND ( c.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} OR 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( c.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( c.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) GROUP BY c.chw_code, c.chw_name ORDER BY c.chw_code
